note: Values of assets-src/venus/place/wide.py: the wide ring about the place (level v, plates.json wide), painted on from the picture of level w window by window. child: the level it carries on. flatDeg, level: the picture of the child is made flat in tone, its light over its own light blurred at flatDeg (degrees of arc), at this level of light. window: size of a window in plate pixels (the size of a take), cell: the plate is counted in cells of this many pixels, context: least share of a window that must be there already, reach: no new cell lies further than this many pixels from picture inside its window, gap: new cells keep this many pixels from picture their window does not show (picture outside it, and what another window of the same wave paints), least: a wave takes further windows only while they bring this share of a window of new picture, most: windows per wave, shun: a new window keeps this many pixels (the larger of the two offsets) from a window that was given up. sketch: the layout the empty part of an input shows, three flat tones (tones: deck, tower, shadow, display values; soft: the outline of a tower and of a shadow is softened at these pixels), from seed: perMpx towers per million pixels, scattered with a share of the mean between the two values of share along a slow wave of this many pixels, no two nearer than apart pixels, radius of a tower (median, spread of its logarithm, least, most, pixels), lobes: smaller rounds about each, shadow: its length in radii between the two values, taper: the share of its width it loses to its end, rows: rows of towers per million pixels with count towers each, a step between them in radii and a bend per step in radians. edge: where the picture of a window ends in the sketch, fade is the width of the soft end (share of the window), wander its two waves (amount as a share of the window, size in pixels), bound: the waves are held within this share of the window and the soft end begins this far inside the picture, so no picture stands at the border of the cells, seed of the waves. lock: the tone of a take is locked to the picture that is there, ratio of the two blurred at sigma pixels, floor: weight of the ratio of the whole window where no picture is near, most: bound of the ratio either way. judge: a take is not laid when its strongest straight line (the mean step from one row or column to the next over its median along the picture) is over line, or when it holds the same forms twice (the highest value of its own correlation at a shift of more than 320 pixels) over twice. cut: the take is cut in along the line of least difference inside band pixels of the picture that is there, difference smoothed at smooth pixels, counted at one in step pixels, softened by feather pixels. sun: the direction of the shadows is where the parts darker than dark (of the flat level) lie from the parts brighter than top, between reach pixels at a sixteenth of the size. quality: of the JPEG.
